sources.quote: Lambda Andromedae, Latinized from λ Andromedae, also named Udkadua, is a binary star system in the northern constellation of Andromeda.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 24 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,667 K, so 7.552 solar radii.
